Thanks Jonas — great summary. Markus, quick read of the PDF and some internal notes / proposed redlines below. I attached an editable tier spreadsheet so we can iterate.

Summary of proposed commission ladder (draft):
- Tier 1: $0 – $499,999 ARR introduced = 10% rev share
- Tier 2: $500,000 – $999,999 = 12.5%
- Tier 3: $1,000,000+ = 15%

Operational notes:
- Lead registration mechanism: HubSpot registration + confirmation email. Evidence for payout = PO or executed SOW recorded in HubSpot within 30 days of registration.
- Clawback: 6-month proration window from invoice for refunds / cancellations; apply against next payouts.
- Implementation-only carve-out: if BlueStone performs purely professional services and the buyer does not adopt production usage of Redwood within 90 days, compensation is a one-time referral fee (flat 15% of first-year implementation fee) rather than rev share.
- Retro credits: we can consider a credit for pipeline that has a signed SOW executed in the last 60 days, subject to verification and a single quarter payout cap.

Next steps I propose:
1) BlueStone to provide list of pipeline deals they expect to register for retro consideration (format: HubSpot link, company, stage, ARR estimate).
2) Redwood deal desk (Karthik) to validate and approve up to X deals for retro credit.
3) Legal to draft a short addendum and schedule an exec sign-off.

Attachment: redline_partner_tiers.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)

Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
